description: This file defines the class FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerCondition, which extends PropertiesCondition and checks various configuration conditions related to remote job message handling, particularly focusing on message handlers and batch modes within the Fineract system.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerCondition
classes.description: A condition class that evaluates whether specific message handler configurations are satisfied, such as enabling only one message handler type and ensuring proper batch mode and event settings for remote job message handling.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the base method to evaluate if the current configuration matches the conditions for enabling remote job message handling based on Spring events, JMS, and batch modes.

methods.name: isOnlyOneMessageHandlerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if exactly one message handler (Spring Events or JMS) is enabled.

methods.name: isAnyMessageHandlerConfigured
methods.description: Determines if at least one message handler (Spring Events or JMS) is enabled.

methods.name: isBatchInstance
methods.description: Checks if either Batch Manager or Batch Worker mode is enabled.

methods.name: isBatchManagerAndWorkerTogether
methods.description: Checks if both Batch Manager and Batch Worker modes are enabled simultaneously.
